name: Novita AI
tagline: One API for many AI models, plus agent sandboxes and GPU cloud.
description: Novita AI is an AI and agent cloud for developers that combines serverless model APIs with on-demand compute. A single API serves 120+ text, image, audio, video, and vision models, while Agent Sandbox provides isolated runtimes for tool-using agents and the GPU cloud offers dedicated instances, serverless GPUs, and bare-metal clusters. It advertises sub-50ms time-to-first-token and startup-friendly, usage-based pricing.
insight: An official Hugging Face inference provider, serving open models to Hugging Face's 5M+ developers via a 'Deploy on Novita' experience.

modelSupport.notes: 120+ LLMs and multimodal models via one API, plus GPU instances and agent sandboxes.

edge: Pairs serverless model APIs with on-demand GPU instances and isolated agent sandboxes in one platform, so inference and the compute to run agents live together.
pros: Text, image, audio, video, vision models

references.title: Introducing serverless inference providers: Nebius, Novita, Hyperbolic
